comments.text:
Interesting story. I’m 50 and grew up near Milwaukee, Wisconsin.

I remember capsules and the Tylenol capsule scare, which I guess happened when I was about eight.

I never heard of other capsules being tainted, but as a little kid mucking around where I shouldn’t have been, I learned capsules were easy to disassemble and reassemble.

No wonder they quickly got pulled off the market, and replaced by “caplets,” which were basically a solid pill with a similar shape and possibly a similar coating, but more like a one-piece monocoque construction.

On a side-note, one of the strangest things I ever found as a little kid, was one of these medicine capsules with a tiny tightly rolled-up piece of paper with a typed message, more like a phrase,  inside. I found it somewhere playing outside in the dirt, and I can’t remember what was typed on the paper because it didn’t make any sense to me at the time… 

I still have no idea what it really was, and my only guess is that it might have fallen off of a homing pigeon, and somehow survived the elements until I found it….
